ui.design_rationale: The requested date-range filtering belongs to a consumer order-history flow, so warm stone surfaces, amber accents, and friendly Figtree typography fit the ecommerce context.

files.purpose: Extend list_orders with optional inclusive created_at timestamp bounds while preserving the existing user filter, returned order fields, and behavior when bounds are omitted.

verify.steps: Call list_orders with from_date and to_date and confirm results include orders created exactly at either boundary, exclude orders outside the range, and remain unchanged when both optional arguments are omitted.

assumption: The endpoint should compare the timestamp strings in their existing created_at representation, with inclusive lower and upper bounds and no parsing or validation behavior beyond the requested filtering.
